work Professional Experience

Sr. Software Engineer • Mobile Technical Lead

DoorDash
Nov '21 – Present (4+ yrs)
  • Mobile Consumer Experience & Order Confirmation: Served as Mobile Technical Lead driving both Android and iOS feature parity; engineered the Order Confirmation UI flow from scratch to serve millions of daily orders, delivering an extensible surface for dynamic ETA estimation, multi-store order details (split pickup/delivery fulfillment), and targeted promotional placements.
  • Dynamic Delivery Options Architecture: Designed and deployed the backend-driven Dynamic Delivery Options framework, orchestrating backend infrastructure configurations with reactive Android UI logic and leading iOS cross-functional adoption to enable zero-app-release delivery window experimentation.
  • Hardware Integration (Hardware Peripherals): Led end-to-end mobile hardware integration for connected external hardware peripherals and fulfillment devices.
  • CI Build Time & Visual Regression Testing: Drove CI build time optimizations and established automated Jetpack Compose visual regression / screenshot testing pipelines across the mobile organization.
  • Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Modernization: Implemented Cart Redirection (single and multi-item) leveraging DoorDash's proprietary SDUI framework and led the mobile rescheduling UI redesign.
  • Observability, Reliability & Mentorship: Consolidated pre-checkout telemetry with analytics and data science teams; led on-call leadership rotations, operational reviews, and post-mortems while championing org-wide Kotlin craftsmanship through technical newsletters and RFC reviews.
Stack: Jetpack Compose Kotlin Coroutines SDUI Hardware Peripherals Visual Regression Testing CI/CD Optimization Multi-Module Architecture
